HDS-001.summary: The byte-pinned official V2.2a publication confirms that HDS remains intentionally non-XSD. The current V2.2a table recognises both _http._tcp and _ibisip_http._tcp; _http._tcp is deprecated/future-not-recommended, while _ibisip_http._tcp is the documented transition/future label. Deletion of _http._tcp is reserved for the future next service version after 2.2.

version_profile.transition_label_status: _ibisip_http._tcp documented for future use and already project-usable by mutual agreement in V2.2
version_profile.future_next_version_rule: next service version after 2.2 will use _ibisip_http._tcp and delete _http._tcp
